db:insert.doc:name: Create Import Audit
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO catalog_import_runs (run_id, file_name, file_checksum, extract_type, run_status, started_at) VALUES (:runId, :fileName, SHA2(:rawText, 256), :extractType, :runStatus, NOW())

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var text = (vars.rawCatalogText default "") as String var lines = text splitBy /\r?\n/ var nonBlank = lines filter ((line) -> !isEmpty(trim(line))) var dataLines = nonBlank filter ((line) -> lower(trim(line)) != "sku|productname|categorycode|brand|price|currency|taxclass|stockstatus|productstatus|shortdescription|imagepath|updatedat") --- dataLines map ((line) -> do { var c = line splitBy /\|/ var priceText = trim(c[4] default "") --- { sku: trim(c[0] default ""), productName: trim(c[1] default ""), categoryCode: trim(c[2] default ""), brand: trim(c[3] default ""), priceText: priceText, price: if (priceText matches /^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$/) priceText as Number else null, currency: upper(trim(c[5] default "")), taxClass: trim(c[6] default ""), stockStatus: upper(trim(c[7] default "")), productStatus: upper(trim(c[8] default "")), shortDescription: trim(c[9] default ""), imagePath: trim(c[10] default ""), updatedAt: trim(c[11] default "") } })

%dw 2.0 import dw::Crypto import toBase64 from dw::core::Binaries output application/java
var allowedStatuses = ["ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "DRAFT"] var allowedStockStatuses = ["IN_STOCK", "OUT_OF_STOCK", "BACKORDER", "LOW_STOCK"]
--- payload map ((p) -> do { var sku = trim((p.sku default "") as String) var productName = trim((p.productName default "") as String) var categoryCode = trim((p.categoryCode default "") as String) var brand = trim((p.brand default "") as String) var currency = upper(trim((p.currency default "") as String)) var taxClass = trim((p.taxClass default "") as String) var stockStatus = upper(trim((p.stockStatus default "") as String)) var productStatus = upper(trim((p.productStatus default "") as String)) var imagePath = trim((p.imagePath default "") as String) var price = p.price default null
var validationMessage = if (isEmpty(sku)) "Missing SKU" else if (isEmpty(productName)) "Missing product name" else if (isEmpty(categoryCode)) "Missing category code" else if (isEmpty(brand)) "Missing brand" else if (price == null) "Price must be a positive numeric value" else if ((price as Number) <= 0) "Price must be positive" else if (isEmpty(currency) or not (currency matches /^[A-Z]{3}$/)) "Currency must be a 3-letter code" else if (isEmpty(taxClass)) "Missing tax class" else if (isEmpty(stockStatus) or not (allowedStockStatuses contains stockStatus)) "Unsupported stock status" else if (isEmpty(productStatus) or not (allowedStatuses contains productStatus)) "Unsupported product status" else if (isEmpty(imagePath)) "Missing image path" else if (not (imagePath matches /^\/images\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/)) "Malformed image path" else null
var businessFields = { sku: sku, productName: productName, categoryCode: categoryCode, brand: brand, price: price, currency: currency, taxClass: taxClass, stockStatus: stockStatus, productStatus: productStatus, shortDescription: p.shortDescription default "", imagePath: imagePath }
var canonicalJson = write(businessFields, "application/json")
--- p ++ { sku: sku, productName: productName, categoryCode: categoryCode, brand: brand, price: price, currency: currency, taxClass: taxClass, stockStatus: stockStatus, productStatus: productStatus, shortDescription: p.shortDescription default "", imagePath: imagePath, valid: validationMessage == null, validationMessage: if (validationMessage == null) "Valid" else validationMessage, contentHash: if (validationMessage == null) toBase64(Crypto::hashWith(canonicalJson as Binary, "SHA-256")) else null } })
